notes.title: Demo Update 0.3
notes.content:
Demo Patch Notes: Update 0.3

Improvements:

Added friends invite feature for multiplayer sessions

Enhanced matchmaking for better connectivity

Improved melee animations and hit detection

Fixes:

Interaction with the Game Over screen is now possible

Slide is now only allowed while running

Instantly leave the lobby without repeated attempts

Fixed issues where the pause menu would not close

All settings now apply correctly

Reload advice is now removed when switching weapons

Spectator UI is now removing correctly after respawn



Important Notice

There is currently an issue with the Steam subsystem in the engine, which causes multiplayer to not work correctly.

I am actively working on a solution and will provide an update as soon as the issue is resolved.

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.2
notes.content:
Demo Patch Notes: Initial Hotfix 0.2

A Small patch to address immediate feedback and bugs.

Prevented zombies from spawning after a wave.

Fixed Drake-12 texture.

Corrected revive widget display.

Ensured turret widget displays properly.

Disabled reloading while sprinting.

Added game credits.

Updated M1911 shoot sound.

Resolved scalability setting reset.

Disabled back button in player lobby.

Added "Go to Menu" in Pause Settings.
